create.name: Jason Crandell
create.bio:
Jason Crandell is a yoga teacher and teacher trainer with more than two decades of teaching behind him. His main teacher was Rodney Yee, and he was a staff teacher at Yoga Journal, where he met his wife and teaching partner, the writer Andrea Ferretti. Over the years he has also learned from physical therapists, sports-medicine specialists and other movement researchers, and his trademark is clear, practical instruction that joins classical yoga philosophy with current understanding of how bodies move and change.

Together he and Andrea run the Jason Crandell Yoga Method, an online school for yoga education, and Yogaland, a long-running podcast on practising and teaching yoga that has passed several million downloads. Jason's Yoga Alliance-accredited 200- and 300-hour online teacher trainings and shorter courses cover sequencing, breathwork and pranayama, anatomy and teaching beginners, and he leads occasional in-person immersions and retreats, including in San Francisco and London. His YouTube channel mixes teaching tips, practice sequences, strength and mobility work, and conversations on yoga philosophy and the life of a teacher.
